  • Reference

    Performs Unfolding analysis

    unfolding_analysis.Rd

    Performs Unfolding analysis

    unfolding_analysis(
  file_path,
  sheet_liking = NULL,
  mode = "internal",
  sheet_products = NULL,
  sheet_subjects = NULL,
  coef_biplot = 1,
  scale_subj = 1,
  min_r2 = 1,
  ridge_x = 0.001,
  ridge_y = 0.001,
  ndim = 2,
  itmax = 10000,
  type_unfold = "ordinal",
  conditionality = "row",
  method_diss = "reverse",
  clustering = TRUE,
  n_clusters = NULL,
  max_k = 6,
  label_consumers = FALSE,
  plot3D = FALSE,
  short_id = NULL,
  out_dir = NULL,
  save_tiff = TRUE,
  dpi = 300,
  ...
)

    Arguments

    file_path

    Path to the input Excel file.

    sheet_liking

    Name of sheet containing liking data.

    mode

    Unfolding mode: "internal", "external", "restricted_prod", "restricted_subj", or "restricted_both".

    sheet_products

    Sheet name for product variables.

    sheet_subjects

    Sheet name for consumer variables.

    coef_biplot

    Scaling factor for product vectors.

    scale_subj

    Scaling factor for subject vectors.

    min_r2

    Minimum R2 threshold for product vectors (default: 1.0).

    ridge_x

    Ridge regularization parameter for products.

    ridge_y

    Ridge regularization parameter for subjects.

    ndim

    Dimensions.

    itmax

    Maximum iterations (default: 10000).

    type_unfold

    Unfolding type ("ordinal", "interval", "ratio").

    conditionality

    Conditionality ("row", "unconditional").

    method_diss

    Dissimilarity method ("reverse", "rank").

    clustering

    Logical for consumer clustering.

    n_clusters

    Forced cluster count.

    max_k

    Max clusters for Silhouette search.

    label_consumers

    Display consumer labels on plot.

    plot3D

    Generate 3D interactive plot.

    short_id

    Short identifier for files.

    out_dir

    Output directory.

    save_tiff

    Export TIFF files.

    dpi

    DPI resolution.

    ...

    Additional arguments.

    Value

    A list with Unfolding model results and plots.
